groups.id: forearm borrowed product validation has exact scope
groups.comparison: ForearmSurfaceInput validates nonblank domain, positions/normals/packedskin/weights row equality, face count equals texcoord-face count, names/global state count, packed joint count, and each morph positions/normals/joint-state counts. It requires nonempty selected lowarm skin family. Upperarm+wrist intentionally support forearm boundary while fitting ownership remains lowarm. It does not prove face or texcoord indices in bounds, actual UV row membership, finite values, same-rig identity or unique morph names; direct fitting methods remain separate lower obligations. Public fields plus these checks are not a sealed full mesh.

groups.id: export derives corresponding parallel arrays in one traversal
groups.comparison: Character export resolves loadout, generated body/morph samples, armor and lining once, then constructs body targets, clothing targets, plate/lacing faces+targets and material textures from those same current collections. piece_geometry returns one entry per armor including empty when no lacing, so later plates.faces[i]/targets[i] and lacing counterparts share length/order with source armor on normal local path. Catalog steel/trim materials deduplicated by actual Metal equality, relookup includes same engraving/trim source; missing trim texture errors before final GLB write. Component shells/hinges/faces use ranges derived GeneratedArmor::surfaces lower contract, not all raw range validity from this adapter.

groups.id: supplied drape list versus automatic prefix path
groups.comparison: prepare None builds ordered drape_inputs and uses outcome.garments, carries problems and missing-count warnings, empty wornlist yields empty. Source does not itself prove outcome prefix, so retain actual lower drape_outfit guarantee rather than infer filter_map hole. Some(fitted) borrows list without binding body/loadout/recipe; mail_surfaces pairs its index with current loadout.draped and checks existence, then uses current selection mail when retained garment fabric Chainmail. Thus normal supplied-list producer identity/count/order remains a real direct caller obligation; no wrong normal output asserted from unrelated raw arrays. Validation adds clearance/contact warnings and accumulates earlier garment geometry for later garment contacts; warnings intentionally do not fail export. No hidden claim all weak drapes are rejected.

groups.id: morph deltas and skeleton motion have separate responsibilities
groups.comparison: MorphDelta::between requires base/sample positions equal length and base/sample normals equal length, computes per-row differences; separate pos↔normal relation still depends source model. generate IdentityMorph channels samples recipe identity+step in same order, and SkeletalFitMorph samples checked proportion endpoint but deliberately body position deltas zero: skeleton translations carry that part. Samples include their exact global joint state and fresh DeviceBody, not neutral joint landmarks. clothing refit and correct_armor_fit remove strongest-four weighted bone displacement only for recognized skeletal morph names to avoid double motion; original fixtures reconstruct direct endpoint from residual plus exported influence motion. Actual normal clothing uses full body vertex rows as proved below, so body skin indexing is not an inferred garment-subset mismatch. Unrecognized channels unchanged.

groups.id: hair export owns geometry skin texture and morph dependencies
groups.comparison: ExportedHair grows current groom, fits BodyHead to generated model, derives cards at fixed exported form, whole-joint skin repeated exact card count checked against current rig count, and per-row weights from same influence. Hair morph refits each sample head and carries same base geometry, creates matching repeated head skin for residual correction. Private ExportedHair holds cards/skin/textures/morphs for borrowed shell lifetime; no independently mutable parallel public arrays at this adapter. Atlas firstlevel required, shade+coverage from same RGBA groups, tinted channels sRGB encoding with coverage alpha, PNG encoder fallible. Native atlas pixel dimensions, GPU placement and carried topology body contracts not credited from method names. Cached headless GPU includes initial error intentionally memoized, no actual opening attempt performed.

groups.id: actual placeholder clothing admission and full-body rows
groups.comparison: generate_clothing_shells rejects positions/normals/packedindices/weights row mismatch, names/global joint mismatch, packed count mismatch, or any source face vertex out of bounds before region or geometry indexing. Each specification resolves actual region landmarks, measures skin-weighted chain bounds, rejects no weighted vertices/no spans/no selected triangles. Selects faces by body vertex coverage, expansion keeps indices in same original faces and terminates early fixedpoint; waist closure extends selection with explicit lower .01 threshold. fitted_surface clones ALL input positions and computes same-length normals rather than compacting subset; selected face references stay original body ordinals. This proves actual normal ClothingShell rows align body skin for character_morphs residual and unskinned export fallback. visible_body_faces removes exact selected face ordinals only when occludes_body, no separate vertex identity map.

groups.id: placeholder fitting is finite topology not quality acceptance
groups.comparison: relax_concavities derives adjacency from checked original indices, preserves boundary vertices and uses outward-only lift; weighted averages multiply inverse neighbor count before fold. Surface normals normalize or preserve supplied fallback; fitted offset reuses checked SignedLength and welds quantized source-coincident rows with f64 averaging. validated_placeholder_faces rejects any nonfinite fitted position or out-of-range face and otherwise preserves exact face sequence; does not impose positive area/closed topology/orientation quality, consistent explicit arbitrary-deformation test. Refit checks body row count then runs same fit and preserves faces; raw public ClothingShell with invalid retained face can index before late validation, additional API support of F060 indexed geometry ownership graph. Normal generated shell has source membership proved before fit.

groups.id: anatomical selection is scoped and intentional
groups.comparison: ClothingRig caches RegionBinding under immutable borrowed joint names, require_in resolves first exact duplicate landmark in requested region order and preserves error precedence. Skin membership retains every matching slot independently of first landmark; spans union selected sets but retain ordered segment vector. Waist support exact root/spine0/spine1 plus thigh twist families, excludes spine twists. skin_family includes owner or every owner_twist prefix including unfamiliar suffix, explicitly confirmed by existing fixtures; no grammar tightening or reinterpret unfamiliar suffix as missing skeleton member. RegionRig maps all enum anatomical regions explicitly to proximal/distal names and membership policies. Equal joint counts alone do not seal different rig ordering.

groups.id: piece identity errors and CLI scope
groups.comparison: ClothingPieceName and ClothingFaceContext retain original display garment and encoded triangle for typed errors; they intentionally accept open labels/u32 triples rather than claim admitted geometry. CLI LOD parser constrains native u8 to imported MIN/MAX constants; armor_bake_source requires reviewdir, equipment_item requires generate_equipment, reviewselection requires reviewdir. Direct Args fields remain broader native config; no whole application mode exclusivity inferred where none declared. Remaining paths are explicit native filesystem ports, no execution.

Read complete chainmail ignored integration fixture requiring MHR_ASSETS and cached measured drape: it checks cached body equality, transfers skin and later retransfers after diagnostics before export, inspects material alpha/metal/textures. This is source evidence only, no cached measurement or GPU/GLB run claimed. Read full clothing anchor, multi-bone coordinate, concavity boundaries, normals, intentional placeholder deformation/nonfinite/missing face, split-row welding, material offset and typed missing-landmark fixtures, plus morph residual reconstruction fixtures. No newly authored cases/assertions or execution.
